title: decision provider report
description: GET /v1/fleet/decision-providers/report?hours=&provider= (SRV-851): from the conductor's journal (rows kind provider; this process's memory when the controller runs no conductor journal): providers -> question id -> bucket (on, shadow, ab_a, ab_b) -> calls, answered, failures, fallbacks, fallback_reasons (each reason the built-in answered instead, counted: timeout, breaker_open, provider_down, unknown_label, http_<status>, ...), compared and agreed (shadow: the provider's answer against the conductor's decision), agreement_pct, p50_ms and p95_ms (the provider's time; arm a: the built-in decider's), labels (the answers used; shadow: the provider's)

fallback_reasons.description: reason -> how many fallbacks it caused; the counts add up to `fallbacks`
